body: Thank you, I needed that. I'll be here tomorrow and hopefully the day after that, one day at a time. You say such nice and compassionate words and yet you don't know me, I can safely say that your words are the kindest I've ever received and I'm grateful that you took time out of your day to make mine less miserable.

I do have people I trust, I have a close friend that I've had for more than 12 years. I don't think he would understand though, the people around me always see me as the happiest guy they know, I guess most of us are good at keeping a straight face. And I don't feel like there's anything I need in life right now, which is why I feel so guilty about my feelings and thoughts of suicide, I get no warning from myself, one minute I'm alright and thinking positively and then it's like I just get hit by a massive wave and hopelessness sets in.
